issues: 框内面板是灰色骨架条，下半截空白，看不出是什么页面
弧线中段 scale 推到 1.0，面板左上角与霓虹框顶出画框
悬空组件被面板 overflow 裁切，标题和品牌行在半空被切掉一截
软影是内容的灰色模糊副本且越高越深，读作脏糊块
没有导出时长，按默认 150f 渲染
changes: 面板换成与姊妹镜同款的出版级工作台首页（导航、问候标题、搜索、最近卡、任务表），面板高 900→790
机位缩一档：scale 0.8→(弧线中段 +0.08)→落定 0.9，全程整框留在画内；旋转弧线 +38°→−26° 与同帧齐落 LAND=0.52 不变
页面不再裁切，悬空组件按透视自然探出面板边缘；软影改纯剪影，越高越大越虚越淡，悬空本体按高度微放大
面板补深色落地影，背景管减细到 1.6px，加暗角与颗粒
补导出 NEON_FRAME_FORERUN_ORBIT_DURATION=140（旋转 128f 收住后留落定）
issuesEn: The panel was grey skeleton bars with an empty lower half, so you could not tell what page it was
Mid-arc the scale reached 1.0 and the panel's top-left corner and neon frame left the frame
Floating parts were clipped by the panel's overflow, so the title and brand row were cut in mid-air
Shadows were blurred grey copies of the content that got darker with height, reading as smudges
No duration export, so it rendered the default 150f
changesEn: The panel uses the same publication-grade workspace home as its sister shot (nav, greeting, search, recent cards, task table), height 900→790
Camera pulled back one step: scale 0.8 → +0.08 mid-arc → 0.9 at rest, keeping the whole frame in shot; the +38°→−26° arc and the simultaneous LAND=0.52 drop are unchanged

The page no longer clips, so floating parts overhang the panel edge in perspective; shadows are pure silhouettes that grow larger, softer and fainter with height, and floating parts scale slightly with height
Deep drop shadow under the panel, background tubes thinned to 1.6px, plus vignette and grain
Added NEON_FRAME_FORERUN_ORBIT_DURATION=140 (settle hold after the rotation ends at 128f)
